slurmJobGroups.title: Slurm job groups
slurmJobGroups.description: A regular expression matched against Slurm job names. Jobs that match are grouped in the Slurm tab under capture group 1, and shown by capture group 2 (or the whole name). Empty: no grouping. Example: ^(myexp-[0-9a-f]{12})-(.*)$
